title: Blue Blaze
description: A simple visual tweak that turns Blazes blue, replacing their normal orange fire with a cool blue flame.
body:
This resource pack gives Blazes a fresh new look by changing their fire color from the default orange to a striking blue.
It keeps the original Minecraft style while making Blazes stand out more in the Nether. Perfect if you want a cleaner, cooler, or more magical aesthetic without altering gameplay.

Can also be good to sopt them super easy when traveling in the nether!
